text:
Marvel didn't just show Hawkeye's feet, they showed Spiderman's too. Just look at that close-up 😍
Someone clearly likes animating the heroes barefoot.

Hey everyone! After a long time, Goku and Gohan are back in a new story.
Goku's Day on Earth is coming this month.

Alright, you convinced me. I'm going to watch this series just for this scene.
I've watching this guy move his toes all day.
This episode made me fall in love with Hawkeye. Thank you, Marvel! ❤️
Roy is off on a new adventure! Of course Fuecoco and Latias are coming with him. Hope you like it.
Remembering the first story we did with Nakamura and Hirose. We based it on the episode where they get locked in the room behind the gym. Did you like this comic? 😊
A little piece from one of last month's comics. Nakamura has no limits when it comes to imagining himself in different situations with Hirose.
This was a very specific request. Kai from Ninjago, but in his Fortnite skin. It was fun to do 😉
Nightwing agreed to play with you! What are you going to do first?
First time doing something related to Detective Conan. What do you think they're doing to Shinichi Kudo? 😉
